objective: Assess normal UniCal on usual KITTI versus KITTI-C2L, then assess additional gains from sequence fusion.
compute: Local RTX A4000 only; serial training jobs.
baseline_code: main 7c16fd8; preserve model architecture and implementation for exact baseline runs.
common_primary_regime: Usual relative errors +/-1 degree and +/-10 cm; C2L native stage 5. Native dual errors have a different relative distribution.
controls: Exact main on usual KITTI pipeline, evaluated on both common relative and native C2L targets.
Exact main on published C2L frames, evaluated on the same common held-out frames and both protocols.
Matched-frame relative protocol control to isolate protocol from capture-day/scene selection.
Branch T=1 frame model to isolate implementation corrections from temporal fusion.
Branch T=1 frame model with pretrained-compatible MobileViT BGR/[0,1] inputs; isolate preprocessing from temporal gains. Keep legacy preprocessing for exact main and implementation controls.
Branch window T=1/T=3 mean with identical published targets and anchors.
Branch window T=1/T=3 Transformer with identical architecture and capacity.
Branch window T=1/T=3 GRU if needed to assess the alternative temporal architecture.
validation_rules: Select checkpoints using validation only; evaluate held-out test after selection.
Use seeds 42, 43, 44 for decisive comparisons after pilots.
Start with pilots, broaden to multiple complete/diverse sequences and all held-out test sequences; do not conclude from the initial contiguous slice.
Verify train/validation/test raw frame identities do not overlap.
KITTI usual test drive 0028 overlaps C2L training sequence 08; never treat it as an unseen shared test for a model trained on sequence 08.
Use common held-out sequences 09 and 10 for cross-dataset comparisons.
Report geodesic degrees, per-axis translation MAE in cm, and identity-correction reference.
Pair predictions by sample ID; estimate uncertainty by non-overlapping temporal block/window and training seed.
Require stable validation learning curves and report both optimizer updates and backbone frames processed.
Report fixed-target versus online-resampled training as a separate protocol factor.

decision_rules.dataset_noninferiority: Predeclare 10% relative error margin on each metric versus usual training, using paired held-out predictions. Report both test protocols and any tradeoff.
decision_rules.temporal_improvement: Paired 95% interval supports a reduction in at least one metric, with the other within the 10% noninferiority margin; verify across seeds and capacity-matched T=1 controls.
decision_rules.insufficient_evidence: Do not claim parity or improvement from smoke runs, training loss alone, failure to reject a difference, or an underfit identity-level baseline.

remaining: Run broader normal-model comparisons to validation stability
Replicate decisive results and assess uncertainty

full_corpus_phase.normalization: imagenet_rgb for exact-main and primary implementation/temporal controls
full_corpus_phase.training_budget: Full-corpus T=1 starts with roughly 185,000 backbone frames; report actual optimizer updates and frames for every arm. T=3 has three times the frame exposure at matched anchor epochs. Shortened epoch count reflects corpus size; validation stability remains required, and underfit runs must be extended or diagnosed.
full_corpus_phase.usual_KITTI_budget: Use all configured usual KITTI drives, selecting epoch count to approximately match full-C2L frame exposure; retain the main architecture, data pipeline and optimizer, with the same recorded warmup override.

completed_asset_inventory.KITTI_C2L: Full frame and window corpus verified and frozen; source commit d4ba9d7; source frames 19608 train and 2792 test.

usual_KITTI.loader_configuration_dry_run: main unchanged, 13 epochs for target exposure 185070 frames, warmup 1 epoch

optimized_phase.requested_by_user: Improve speed and efficiency while retaining the two goals: sequence UniCal and C2L versus usual KITTI validation.
optimized_phase.point_subsampling: Deterministic, evenly spaced loss-point subset after dense input-map construction. Targets and full input LiDAR map are unchanged.
optimized_phase.fairness: Apply identical optimized settings to both dataset training arms and all matched temporal controls. Restart optimized arms from initialization; never mix resolutions/precision/point caps within a reported arm. Preserve original 512px checkpoints as explicitly interrupted references.
optimized_phase.initial_benchmark: Main single frame approximately 82 anchors/s; original short benchmark approximately 16 anchors/s. Three-frame control approximately 37 anchors/s (110 backbone frames/s), finite losses, about 2.7GiB peak GPU allocation. Confirm sustained epoch throughput and accuracy.
optimized_phase.publication_decision: A reference-dataset claim requires successful useful calibration, not merely parity at identity-level error; validation stability and three-seed paired held-out tests still required.

published_accuracy_reference.paper: UniCal: a Single-Branch Transformer-Based Model for Camera-to-LiDAR Calibration and Validation

primary_reference.split: alpha: train KITTI raw 2011_09_26, val drives 5/70, test 2011_09_30 drive 28

published_accuracy_reference.metric_alignment: Paper regresses roll/pitch/yaw and labels its metric rotation MAE; report XYZ Euler per-axis MAE separately from geodesic rotation error. Do not equate geodesic degrees with the paper table without establishing its definition.
published_accuracy_reference.scope: C2L-vs-usual comparisons on common 09/10 establish internal dataset parity and absolute accuracy quality, but are not exact paper split-alpha reproductions. The C2L training corpus contains sequence 08 (raw test-alpha drive 28); exclude that sequence from a separate paper-compatible C2L training arm before using drive 28 as an unseen test.
published_accuracy_reference.success_target: Demonstrate useful near-paper-level calibration as well as noninferiority to the reproduced usual-KITTI baseline. Identity-level parity is insufficient.
published_accuracy_reference.reimplementation_differences: Current UniCal++ is unofficial and uses RGB, a 6D rotation representation and modified heads; original paper describes roll/pitch/yaw regression and its strongest ablation uses grayscale plus LiDAR intensity.
published_accuracy_reference.evaluation_guard: Paper-alpha requires recorded training provenance. Reject C2L raw drive 2011_09_30/0028 regardless of sequence label, changed training metadata, missing historical metadata hashes, or usual KITTI train/validation exposure. CPU dry-run verifies 5177 test pairs at the training resolution.

separate_c2l_view.heldout_metadata: Byte-identical to the complete frozen C2L snapshot.
separate_c2l_view.scope: Makes paper-alpha test drive unseen; training captures still differ from paper alpha, so this is not an exact paper reproduction.

learning_diagnostics.purpose: Distinguish label/gradient pipeline failures from weak optimization; use training-only samples, never infer benchmark accuracy from micro-overfit.

completed_micro_overfit.interpretation: Pipeline can fit real training targets; normalization and head LR both changed, so this diagnostic does not identify their separate causal effects or establish held-out performance.

learning_diagnostics.queued_control: Full C2L BGR with head LR 3e-5 versus 1e-3, same backbone LR 3e-5, same initialization seed, inputs, targets, precision, loss, and frame budget.
learning_diagnostics.temporal_phase: Test paired T=1/T=3 mean and capacity-matched Transformer using BGR input and head/temporal LR 1e-3, backbone LR 3e-5. All temporal arms share those settings; record these implementation/training changes separately from temporal gains.
followup_accuracy_controls: Same BGR/head LR 1e-3 branch implementation trained on usual KITTI; compare to full C2L branch arm on identical held-out native and relative protocols.
C2L without sequence 08, native and online usual perturbations as separate training arms; evaluate the unseen paper-alpha drive and common C2L holdouts.

Use 185070 target training frames with whole-epoch rounding recorded in manifests. Keep paper-alpha split differences explicit; these first-seed controls do not establish three-seed publication readiness.
